Name: Redguard
Description: The most naturally talented warriors in Tamriel. In addition to their cultural affinities for many weapon and armor styles, they also have a hardy constitution and a natural resistance to disease and poison.
Origins:
Dragontail Mountains: Your uprising under the shadow of the mountain peaks was a happy one. Immersed in Redguard customs, you developed charm, wit and the ability to turn a conversation around.

Alik'r Desert: As a child in the sands of the Alik’r Desert, your education revolved around martial might. You are a prime example of why Redguards are the best warriors.
